ALTERNATIVE HEALTH PROFESSIONALS LEADERSHIP SYMPOSIUM

FEBRUARY 25-28, 2016

 

One of the constant threads of importance for Directors Brian and Anna Maria Clement is educating as many people as possible around the world about the power of a healthy lifestyle and Living Foods.

 

That's why Brian's travel schedule is so packed, and they both lecture tirelessly and passionately every day that they can, year after year, decade after decade.

 

To help them touch more lives, they are excited to offer these inspiring introductions to the Hippocrates program to professionals who have an outreach and clientele who could benefit from the Hippocrates lifestyle. 

As well as having a program introducing these concepts to MDs, we also have an immersion opportunity for those in the Alternative Health Professions; therapists, teachers, and coaches, as well as spa, yoga and fitness studio owners, etc.

The goal is to have professionals understand what Hippocrates is all about, by offering four days to experience the daily activities, lectures, living foods and juices, exercise, and beautiful campus. 

Teaching one person who has a network and clientele that they can share with, then creates that many other informed people. This has been Directors Anna Maria and Brian’s goal throughout the years. Through this sharing of education, people’s lives can be dramatically improved, giving us all back the health we are born with.

If you know of anyone in the Alternative Health Professions who might be interested in this introduction to understand what Hippocrates is all about, please share, or visit www.HealthyEasyGreen.com for details and to register. You can also contact [email protected] for more information and a call-back.

 

The cost for four days, including food, lectures and demos, access to pools saunas and exercise classes (not including lodging) is $195. Lodging is available at the nearby Hampton Inn. 

The more leaders, teachers and health professionals who know about Hippocrates, the more people will understand the power of living foods and positive lifestyle changes. Thanks for sharing!
